name: 胸腔引流管
guards: Inputs and all spatial evidence must use the same original-image coordinate frame.
Model-derived masks and box approximations are predictions, not independent reference annotations.
The current A26 backend covers ETT/NGT/CVC/Swan-Ganz only; it has no chest-drain output.
refusal_rules: Refuse when required evidence is missing, malformed, or its tool returns ToolRefusal.
Refuse measurement over a mask truncated at an internal model field-of-view boundary.
Do not turn raw uncalibrated model scores into calibrated clinical probabilities.
Always block chest-drain conclusions with the current backend; absence from its outputs is not a negative finding.

evaluation_protocol.reference: Independent drain path, side-hole, tip and pleural-space annotations using a drain-capable model.
evaluation_protocol.split: Patient/study-disjoint development, calibration and locked test sets; exclude upstream model training overlap and development examples.
evaluation_protocol.statistics: Retain all failures/refusals; report coverage, refusal and conflict rates with patient-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence intervals; never tune on the locked test set.
evaluation_protocol.acceptance: No clinical accuracy acceptance threshold or calibrated fusion weight has been frozen.

blockers: A26 does not support chest drains; drain/side-hole detection and pleural-space reference must be added.
Function-level evidence/claim executor is not implemented; this protocol is a specification rather than an executable clinical function.
